title.narrative: Strengthening Institutional Capacities for Nutrition in the Health and Education Sectors in Lao PDR, SICAN

description.narrative: Overall Objective: To reduce malnutrition in Lao PDR with a focus on gender and disadvantaged groups. Specific Objective: To strengthen the ability of Government at national and sub national level to support good nutrition practices and deliver services across health and education sectors.
